seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: SoS unofficial districtwide results (100% of precincts, to be certified by July 10, 2026) show only two candidates: Takano (DEM) 65,028 (60.0%) and Steve Manos (REP) 43,291 (40.0%). Both therefore advance. The district lies entirely in Riverside County, per the same results page. The search summary did not say which result the Takano office dates or Manos's council membership came from; the attributions to Wikipedia and Rafu Shimpo are likely but unconfirmed. Takano's Bioguide and house.gov pages were not reached. Education and birth details are gaps because the web-search budget ran out. Incumbent means the current member for district number 39; Prop 50 redrew the boundaries.
